title: Demo: late market data, server patching, earlier VaR deadline
message: It's 23:15. The market data vendor says tonight's closing prices feed will be about 90 minutes late, around 01:00. Infrastructure needs HMEM-02 down for emergency patching from 01:00 to 04:00. Risk has asked for the VaR numbers by 04:30 instead of 05:00. And skip the log analytics indexing tonight.

title: Bank window slips and a high-memory server goes down
message: It's midnight. The bank says their SFTP intake window won't open until 04:00 tonight. HMEM-02 also needs a reboot from 01:00 to 04:00.

title: Supplier EDI late while HMEM-02 is being patched
message: It's 22:15. HMEM-02 is down for patching from 23:15 to 03:15, and supplier EDI messages won't arrive until 02:30.

title: Early market data, but a general server fails
message: It's 22:45. Good news: the market data feed is early, landing at 00:00. Bad news: GEN-01 has a failing disk, take it offline from 00:15 to 04:15. Risk wants positions loaded by 02:00.

title: Busy night: two late feeds, HMEM-02 down, earlier finance pack
message: It's 22:15. US store sales files are delayed until 02:30 and the weather feed until 01:00. HMEM-02 is out of service from 22:30 to 02:30. Finance wants the management pack by 05:30.

title: US sales files two hours late: no schedule can save it
message: It's 22:40. US POS files are delayed two hours.
